Frequently Asked Questions
Use the string method at home — wrap a thin string around the base of your ring finger, mark where it meets, and measure the length in mm. Compare with our size guide: 16.4mm = small, 17.2mm = medium, 18.1mm = large. You can also visit any Mia or Tanishq store for a complimentary ring sizing.
BIS Hallmarking is the Bureau of Indian Standards' official quality certification. It guarantees that the gold purity matches what's stated — so a 14KT ring is exactly 58.5% pure gold. All Mia rings carry this certification, giving you complete peace of mind.
14KT gold contains 58.5% pure gold — it's slightly more durable and affordable, making it ideal for everyday wear rings. 18KT gold is 75% pure, giving it a richer colour and higher intrinsic value, perfect for special occasion and diamond-set rings.
Yes — Mia offers 30-day hassle-free returns for online orders in original condition. Additionally, all Mia jewellery can be exchanged at any Tanishq store across India at any time, as part of our Lifetime Exchange programme.
Yes! Mia offers no-cost EMI on orders above ₹3,000 via major credit cards (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis, Kotak). EMI options from 3 to 24 months are available at checkout. We also accept UPI, net banking, and all major debit/credit cards.
Clean your ring regularly using a soft brush, mild soap, and warm water. Avoid contact with chlorine, perfume, and harsh chemicals. Store separately in a fabric-lined box to prevent scratching. Bring your ring to any Mia store for a free professional cleaning once a year.
All diamonds used in Mia rings are ethically sourced and certified by internationally recognised laboratories (IGI/GIA). Each diamond is graded for the 4Cs — Cut, Colour, Clarity, and Carat — ensuring you receive a ring of guaranteed quality and authenticity.

Select Your Ring Size
Not sure about your ring size? Find it here
Find Your Ring Size
1Wrap a thread or thin strip of paper snugly around the base of the finger you'll wear the ring on.
2Mark the point where the thread overlaps with a pen.
3Lay the thread flat against a ruler and measure the length in millimetres (mm).
4Match your measurement to the chart below to find your size.
Thread lengthRing size
Up to 47.0 mm6
47.0 – 49.0 mm8
49.0 – 51.0 mm10
51.0 – 53.0 mm12
53.0 – 55.3 mm14
55.3 – 57.3 mm16
57.3 – 59.2 mm18
59.2 mm and above20
Tip: if you're between two sizes, pick the larger one — it slides on more comfortably over the knuckle.
